decisions.detail: Ratified via video brief (Loom transcript, Jul 29): blue DS Buttons must not appear in any case preview card. SmartMatch quote/quote-urgent/expired and Incomplete draft converted to signal blocks (match, warning, inactive, warning). Closes the quote-family CTA question from D-010. decisions.title: Operating model v3: divergence reviews in Figma; CD outputs candidates, not decisions
decisions.decidedOn: chat review by Titus (pre-dates figma-verdict discipline this record establishes)
decisions.detail: CD is hard-isolated with no stakeholder access, so divergence prints to the area's Explorations page for on-canvas review; only verdicted winners converge to canon with full binding. CD sessions are disposable and repo-seeded (fresh project + 'this is for the otr-nativeapp repo' prompt); CC files every candidate package so no exploration is lost. Vocabulary: disposable (CD, candidates, open sprints) vs permanent (repo, canon, verdicts). Sprint convention: one CD session = one dated sprint section on Explorations with a verdict card; REVIEWED sprints move to Archive. Canvas v3: plate hues encode section type with 140px header bands; nested sections white; sets bordered with radius/4XL.

decisions.title: Sections ditched; plates are auto-layout frames; demo-well recipe
decisions.source: Video brief 12.20.19 AM + hand-applied reference edits on the Lexicon page (11417:42077)
decisions.carveOut: Pages hosting presentable rigs (Proto) keep rigs at page or section level per lesson 12b3; if that page's plate converts to a frame, rigs move up to page level.
decisions.detail: Presentation plates are FRAMES with auto layout, never sections (sections cannot carry auto layout). Plate recipe: high padding (spacing/13xl 96, user typed 100 raw), large radius (80 raw, no DS token that size, DS-request candidate), fill brand/50, hairline stroke black 10%. Shelf right rail is a demo well: fill global/background/strong, stroke global/border/neutral/default 1px, padding spacing/8xl 48, radius radius/XL 20, content centered both axes, layoutSizingVertical FILL when the left rail is taller. Every numeric binds a DS token: radius and spacing collections mapped in BRAND.md. Nested radius formula: inner = outer minus padding, snapped to the nearest smaller token; never let nested corners pinch. Nesting reads visually: plate (tint) > shelf (white) > index (strong tint). AMENDED (same day, user): demonstrated values are ideas, not directives; never keep them raw. Plate radius binds radius/5XL (36), plate stroke binds global/border/neutral/default. Full numeric sweep: 147 fields token-bound, 61 values snapped to nearest token (ties round down).
